title: New Item
content: There's a new item in the barn—baby chicks in the brooding box.They're posing for their first portrait. Well, actually they don't pose at all. They doze, eat, and poop on a five minute cycle. The sticker is from the grocery store.My other challenge is Handsome the uber-friendly cat. He keeps wanting to jump on my lap and get patted.In keeping with the tradition of titling my sketchbooks with the first words that appear in it, this one is called "New Item."-----MaterialsPentalic Aqua Journal (5 x 8 inch)(Edit--note, this seems to be out of stock, thanks Tom)Moleskine Watercolor Albumis an OK substitute, but the paper isn't 100% cotton like the Pentalic).Schmincke Small Watercolor SetNalgene 2-Ounce JarWatercolor Brush SetGouacheOne Shot Lettering Paint
